name: nano-wallet-xno
what: A Nano wallet as one install: address derivation with checksum validation, receive, send, and an MCP server. Receive-only mode needs no spending key. Sends obey an operator-signed spend mandate.

name: agent-wallet-multirail
what: One payment interface with a Nano rail beside USDC and other rails, plus an operator mandate: the human signs a spend cap, per-payment max, payee list and purpose once, and every send is checked against it.

name: openai-agents-nano-x402
what: Lets an OpenAI Agents SDK agent pay x402 endpoints in XNO from its own key. Honours an operator-signed spend mandate.

name: nano-settlement-verify
what: Prove a XNO payment settled, with no node client and no trust in the payer.

name: nano-receipt-ledger
what: A receipt ledger for agent payments that anyone can check against the public chain.

name: nano-work-queue
what: Paid work where the outside agent is the seller: claim a task with no account, deliver, get paid in XNO.

name: paid-work-queue
what: A static, schema-validated queue of paid work for agents, with the payment receipts published.

name: tollstile-rail-nano
what: A Nano settlement rail for the Tollstile paywall: feeless, instant, payer-published sends.

name: nano-mcp-public
what: A Nano MCP server, so any MCP-capable agent can read accounts and move XNO through tools.

name: nano-accept-settle
what: Non-custodial: in one call, confirm an answer passed its acceptance test and the asker's XNO payment to the answerer settled on chain.

name: bounded-task-spec
what: A pinned, content-hashed contract template for paid agent-to-agent tasks: what is asked, a machine-checkable acceptance test, price, deadline and what the spend buys. Reference validator included.

name: gpt-researcher-x402-retriever
what: A pay-per-call web-search retriever for GPT Researcher, paid over x402 in XNO through a pluggable payer, with a price cap.

name: nano-invoice
what: Bind a Nano (XNO) payment to the order it pays for: one invoice per order key, a unique tagged amount (Nano has no memo), ledger-verified receipts a stranger can re-check, refund instructions that go to the account that actually paid, faucet and own-account sends never counted as income. Non-custodial, stdlib Python.

name: dual-rail
what: Add an XNO settlement leg BESIDE an existing USDC/x402 rail, never instead of it: an agent keeps its current rail and gains a feeless one. Replay-protected, trusts only the node you configure. Python + Node, 56 tests.

name: nano-finality-proof
what: Measure how long an XNO payment takes to confirm on a node you run, so an agent knows when a payment is safe to treat as final. The measuring tool itself (no public instance); each sample is a real 1-raw send. Python, 54 tests + 67 e2e checks.
